Steps:
1. Read textutil.py and identify the off-by-one bug in last_n_lines
2. Fix the bug
3. Add a regression test to test_textutil.py that catches this bug
4. Run tests with: python3 -m unittest -q
5. Verify all tests pass

Make the changes directly yourself. Do not delegate further.
